rows: Optional . Identifier of the user who will receive the message; required unless the message is sent as an ephemeral reply to a callback query. If omitted, then the parameter chat_id of the method is ignored. If specified together with callback_query_id , then it must be the identifier of the user who pressed the button. Must be omitted for messages sent in chats where the bot isn't a member, unless the message is a reply to an ephemeral message. It is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message, especially if they are offline. See here for more details.

Optional . Identifier of the callback query which triggered the message, if any. If specified and receiver_user_id is omitted, then the message is sent as an ephemeral reply to the callback query and will be shown only to the user who pressed the button. Ephemeral replies can't be sent to callback queries from messages in channel direct messages chats. The bot must still answer the callback query using answerCallbackQuery .

Optional . Pass True if the ephemeral message must be shown in place of the original message. Must be False for callback queries from ephemeral messages, which must be edited using regular editEphemeralMessage… methods.

Widget.description: This object describes an HTML widget .
rows: Optional . Unique identifier of the shared widget, which can be used to send the widget again using the method sendSharedWidget ; omitted if the widget isn't shared
Optional . Width of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble
Optional . Height of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the height of the widget isn't fixed
Optional . Public data of the widget, which is available wherever the widget is shown. All messages with a shared widget have the same public data.
Optional . Data of the widget, which is specific to the message

PaidMessagesWaived.description: Describes a service message about the sender of the message using a link of the other user, which allows sending messages to the user without paying Telegram Stars. Currently holds no information.

TonWalletTransfer.description: Describes a service message about a transfer with a TON wallet.
rows: Unique identifier of the transaction; may be empty if the transfer hasn't been sent yet
Address of the transfer peer in the TON blockchain
The amount of transferred cryptocurrency, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number; negative for outgoing transfers
Optional . Comment added to the transfer; omitted if the comment is encrypted

WidgetQueryType.description:
This object describes the type of a query from a widget. Currently, it can be one of
WidgetQueryTypeData WidgetQueryTypeSignData WidgetQueryTypeSentTransaction

WidgetQueryTypeData.description: The query contains data for the bot.
rows: Optional . TON wallet card of the user who sent the query, if it was sent to the bot along with the query

WidgetQueryTypeSignData.description: The query contains data signed by a TON wallet of the user who sent the query. The data is signed for the domain bot<bot_id> , where <bot_id> is the identifier of the bot.
rows: The wallet that signed the data

WidgetQueryTypeSentTransaction.description: The query notifies the bot about a transaction sent from a TON wallet of the user who sent the query.
rows: The wallet from which the transaction was sent
Value of msg_hash of the transaction

WidgetQueryWallet.description: This object describes a TON wallet of the user, which is used in a query from a widget.
rows: Balance of the wallet, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number
Optional . Hex-encoded public key of the wallet; omitted if unknown
Optional . Base64-encoded serialized StateInit of the wallet contract; omitted if and only if public_key is omitted

WidgetQuery.description: This object represents an incoming query from a widget in a message sent by the bot or via the bot. Use answerWidgetQuery to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
rows: Optional . Chat with the message containing the widget; omitted if the widget is in an inline message
Optional . Identifier of the message containing the widget; omitted if the widget is in an inline message
Optional . Identifier of the inline message containing the widget
Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the widget was sent

Optional . For widgets in inline messages, type of the chat to which the message was sent. Can be either “sender” for a private chat with the inline query sender, “private”, “group”, “supergroup”, or “channel”.
Optional . Unique identifier of the shared widget, which sent the query; omitted if the widget isn't shared

SharedWidgetQuery.description: This object represents an incoming query from a forwarded message with a shared widget created by the bot. Use answerWidgetQuery to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
rows: Unique identifier of the shared widget, which sent the query

AreaPosition.description: Describes the position of a rectangle area on a story media or a TON wallet card.
rows: The abscissa of the area's center, as a percentage of the media or the card width
The ordinate of the area's center, as a percentage of the media or the card height
The width of the area's rectangle, as a percentage of the media or the card width
The height of the area's rectangle, as a percentage of the media or the card height
The clockwise rotation angle of the rectangle, in degrees; 0-360
The radius of the rectangle corner rounding, as a percentage of the media or the card width

TonNft.description: This object represents an NFT in the TON blockchain.
rows: Optional . Address of the collection to which the NFT belongs; omitted if unknown
Index of the NFT among all NFTs from the collection as a decimal number
Optional . The unique gift corresponding to the NFT

TonNftAttribute.description: This object represents an attribute of an NFT in the TON blockchain.

TonWalletCardSticker.description: This object describes a sticker on a TON wallet card.
rows: Position of the sticker on the card
The NFT shown as the sticker

TonWalletCard.description: This object describes a TON wallet card, which is shown on the profile page of a user to everyone.
rows: Balance of the wallet, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number
Optional . Address of the NFT of one of the stickers, whose colors must be used for the card background; omitted if the default background must be used

EmojiType.description:
This object describes an emoji. Currently, it can be one of
EmojiTypeEmoji EmojiTypeCustomEmoji

rows: Identifier of the custom emoji. Use getCustomEmojiStickers to get full information about the sticker.

ChatShareTheme.description:
This object describes the theme of the screen for sharing a link to a user or a chat. Currently, it can be one of
ChatShareThemeEmoji ChatShareThemeUniqueGift

ChatShareThemeEmoji.description: The theme with emoji placed on a background.
rows: The emoji; 0-6 regular or custom emoji
Optional . Identifier of the backdrop used as the background; omitted if the default background is used. Use getChatShareThemeBackdrops to get details about the backdrop.

ChatShareThemeUniqueGift.description: The theme based on a unique gift owned by the user or the chat.

ChatShareThemeBackdrops.description: This object contains a list of backdrops, which can be used as the background of a theme of the screen for sharing a link to a user or a chat.

ChatShareThemeBackdrop.description: This object describes a backdrop, which can be used as the background of a theme of the screen for sharing a link to a user or a chat.

getChatShareThemeBackdrops.description: Use this method to get the list of backdrops, which can be used as the background of a theme of the screen for sharing a link to a user or a chat. Requires no parameters. Returns a ChatShareThemeBackdrops object.

answerWidgetQuery.description: Use this method to send an answer to a query from a widget. The query must be answered within 15 seconds. The answer is received only by the widget that sent the query and doesn't change data of the widget; use editMessageWidgetData or editSharedWidgetData to change it. On success, True is returned.
rows: Unique identifier for the query to be answered
Data to be returned to the widget, 0-1024 bytes

verifyUser.description: Verifies a user on behalf of the organization which is represented by the bot. Returns True on success.
rows: Unique identifier of the target user
Custom description for the verification; 0-70 characters. Must be empty if the organization isn't allowed to provide a custom verification description.
Mode for parsing entities in the custom description. See formatting options for more details. Only “text_link” entities are supported.
A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the custom description, which can be specified instead of custom_description_parse_mode . Only “text_link” entities are supported.

verifyChat.description: Verifies a chat on behalf of the organization which is represented by the bot. Returns True on success.
rows: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot, supergroup, or channel in the format @username . Channel direct messages chats can't be verified.
Custom description for the verification; 0-70 characters. Must be empty if the organization isn't allowed to provide a custom verification description.
Mode for parsing entities in the custom description. See formatting options for more details. Only “text_link” entities are supported.
A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the custom description, which can be specified instead of custom_description_parse_mode . Only “text_link” entities are supported.

getUniqueGift.description: Use this method to get information about a unique gift by its name. Returns a UniqueGift object on success.

deleteBusinessAccountGift.description: Deletes a regular gift owned by a managed business account without receiving Telegram Stars for it. Requires the can_convert_gifts_to_stars business bot right. The gift can be deleted only if it isn't limited (the field total_count of the Gift is omitted) and wasn't refunded. Returns True on success.
rows: Unique identifier of the business connection
Unique identifier of the regular gift that should be deleted

editMessageWidgetData.description: Use this method to edit data of a widget in a message sent by the bot or via the bot (for inline bots). Public data of a shared widget can be changed at most once per second. On success, True is returned.
rows: Required if inline_message_id is not specified. Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup in the format @username .

The maximum amount of time in seconds that the public data of the widget may be cached client-side; 5-3600. If omitted, then the current value is kept, which is 30 by default.

rows: Type of the rich text, always “ton_address”
